name: markdown-pdf-studio
description: A local Markdown-to-PDF CLI and visual editor with typography, layout, colour, code, and CSS controls.

scripts.demo: node src/cli.mjs examples/demo.md -o output/pdf/demo.pdf -c examples/config.json --css examples/custom.css
scripts.check: node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/server.mjs && node --check ui/app.js
